chunks: Except the family of Lot; We shall save them all.
ai.seo_question: Who was saved from the destruction of Lot's people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'ajma'een' (all of them) is often interpreted to include even those family members who may not have been fully steadfast, highlighting the comprehensive nature of divine mercy for Lot's household. This verse is frequently cited to illustrate the principle of collective deliverance for a prophet's lineage, contrasting with the total annihilation of their disbelieving community. It underscores the theological concept that God's salvation is not merely individual but can encompass the righteous family unit as a whole.
